title: Long-context KV-cache benchmarking and model-level performance profile publishing
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: We need a repeatable benchmarking and profiling pipeline for KV cache behavior and end-to-end latency/throughput across long-context sequences per-model. This ticket covers: (1) building a harness that replays representative sequence-length distributions, (2) measuring KV cache hit/miss patterns, memory footprint, kernel selection variance, and P50/P95/P99 token-latencies, (3) creating a canonical 'performance profile' JSON per model-version to publish to the model catalog, and (4) adding a model onboarding checklist entry so model owners can opt into publishing profiles and pin versions with documented performance expectations.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Profiling harness can run a configurable sequence-length distribution and output tokens/sec, GPU mem delta, KV-cache hit rate, and latency percentiles per bucket; 2) Two example model profiles produced (one FP16, one quantized) and uploaded to model-catalog service; 3) Documentation and onboarding checklist updated; 4) PM sign-off on profile schema and fields; 5) Integration test that validates profile values exist when a model is pinned in staging.
benchmarking_plan:
- Generate workload traces: (a) synthetic uniform lengths [64,256,1024,4096,8192], (b) sampled customer telemetry sequence-length histogram (aggregate from anonymized usage), (c) pathological prefixes (KV warm/cold).
- Run each workload across model variants: redwood-1.4-large FP16, redwood-2.0-q4_0, and a community LLaMA-65b quantized build.
- Capture metrics: token throughput (tokens/sec), p50/p95/p99 per-token latency, end-to-end latency for first token and steady-state, KV cache hit rate, encoder/decoder kernel hot spots, GPU memory high-water mark, and cpu-side scheduling stalls.
- Repeat with batching sizes [1,2,4,8] and with and without prefix caching enabled.
- Store outputs as newline-delimited JSON and generate per-model summary payload conforming to profile schema.
sequence_distribution_sampling: We will derive a representative sequence distribution from: (1) anonymized telemetry aggregated by length buckets (0-128,129-512,513-2048,2049-8192,>8192); (2) public dataset mixes (Wiki+Stack+Dialog) to emulate diverse token patterns; (3) a 'long-tail' synthetic bucket with 1% of requests at >8192 tokens for tail latency testing. Sampling weights: telemetry 70%, public mix 25%, synthetic long-tail 5%.
results_summary: Preliminary runs (2026-03-12): redwood-1.4-large FP16: p50 per-token 6.8ms, p95 18ms, p99 45ms for 4096 sequences at batch=1; KV-cache hit rate after warm-up 78% on typical traces, GPU mem high-water 22GB. redwood-2.0-q4_0: p50 8.5ms, p95 24ms, p99 60ms at same config; KV-cache hit 74%, memory footprint reduced by ~30% vs FP16. Observations: (a) quantized kernels show higher variance at >4096 tokens due to fallback kernels for attention; (b) batching improves throughput but increases p50 for first token; (c) cold-start (no KV) for long prefixes dominates first-token latency — recommend explicit warm-path or async prefetch for pinned versions.
decisions: 1) Profile schema will include: model_key, model_version, max_context_tested, sequence_length_buckets, per_bucket_metrics (p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens_per_sec, kv_cache_hit_rate, gpu_mem_mb), recommended_batch_size, recommended_quantization, expected_cost_tokens. 2) Model onboarding will require at least one published profile for any version eligible for version-pinning to Dedicated/Private. 3) When a model is pinned, the runtime will surface the published profile as 'expected performance' in Console. 4) Profiles are advisory (read-only) for Hosted but can be used by Dedicated autoscaler heuristics.
next_steps: - Finish harness instrumentation for kernel-level traces (due 2026-03-17). - Generate full telemetry-sampled distribution and re-run benchmarks (due 2026-03-19). - Draft profile schema PR to model-catalog (ENG-4721-PR1) and request PM/Design review (by 2026-03-20). - Add onboarding checklist entry and console display mockups (coord with PM/Design).
blockers: - Access to aggregated anonymized telemetry requires privacy team sign-off (request submitted to PM-privacy-ops). - One kernel tracing hook is blocked behind ENG-4567 which upgrades the serving runtime tracing API.
